d:
I found the lack of older sister incest disturbing.

This one happens to hit the right notes for said niche. It has an arguably slow buld up but it laid its explicit foundations early on. We immediately got their relationship defined early on without much teasing, only the qustion of when they will actually cross the line. The inciting incident and the conflict is nothing to write home about but that's where it hits the right notes. The story feels raw, honest, and doesn't try to overstay its welcome. The exact reason why I adore this kind of doujin works is because of its lack of pretentiousness. It only wants to tell an incestuous story of a younger brother and older sister and it did just that. The drawings are also nothing spectacular but some of the expressions and the sequences were delivered beautifully. There is a lack in variety of position but it feels reasonable given it's their first time after meandering and holding back for long. Which gave the story a semblance of real in itself.

Overall, I adore this little treat. It feels raw and honest just as I said earlier. For an older sister incest, it feels poignant. The older sister acts like one and the somewhat bratty younger brother doesn't go full bratty. Their relationship as siblings who happens to lusts for each other feels believable.

This is my first time doing solo translation (and first upload too, I guess?). Initially I thought it will only take a day to finish (which it did) but then I whimsically decided to clean and redraw the SFX. It ended up taking much more time than I anticipated.I took some liberties with the translation but I hope I don't take it too far or miscomprehend the translations somehow. As for the cleaning and redrawing honestly I'm not too proud of it, the smears are noticeable in some places and the redrawn SFX feels choppy or unfinished at best. But I did what I did, idk whether I will do this again or not as I'm not in a place to think much of the future right now. Suppose if I can see a clear sky in the following month or this will be my parting notes for whatever this life is.

So, apologies if there's any party offended. I'm not sure how but I'll take this one down if requested to, given that I still have the access to.Do point out if there's some error though, I'd appreciate it.

p.s. as for why it's Indonesian while I'm rambling in English; idk, I wanted to do an English translation at first (ignoring the already existed MTL version which I avoid checking) but then I found that seeing the dialogue in Indonesian especially when referring the female protagonist as "Kak" feels much hotter than simply using "Oneechan" in English script or "Sis". "Kak" or "Kakak" is a general term for older sibling in Indonesian (but can also be used to refer anyone older despite of relation), it's not exclusively used for female sibling. If I were to go with local dialects I could use "Mbak" or "Uni" (which is Javanese and Minangnes respectively and used esclusively for female older sobling) but I thought it would dilute or put too much of a deliberation in the translation. Coming up with the translated title is a bit of a headache, the Japanese one is simple and rhymes rather nice. I asked Grok for any suggestions and nothing satisfactory come out of it but it sure gave me soem pointer as where to go. Then I opted for something as simple and cutting the explicit words since if I keeping the explicit word makes it sounds too pulpy (the idea is "Ngewe sewajarnya" or something along the line). I also used Grok for suggestions in the SFX as to not reuse the same variations for the fifitieth times but much of the translations and cleaning/redrawing are all by hands (CSP and my stubbed mind). And also Indonesian is my mother's tongue so that's another reason I guess.

p.p.s. The school name in Japanese is (un)intentional joke I guess. I localize it into "SMA Swasta Saudara Karib" (lit. Close Sibling Private School) but in the redrawn version you can only see as far as "SMA Swasta Saudara Kar-". So you (I mean you, Indonesians) can read it as either "Saudara Karib" as intended or as "Saudara Karya" which sounds much more reasonable (and less double entendre) for a school name.
